snippet.title: Cuffed - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Awaken in a ruined underground lab with your hands permanently bound. In CUFFED, a combat-free survival horror, your shackles are your only tool. Solve intricate systemic puzzles, override facility systems, and outsmart the terrifying specimens hunting you to escape.

Wishlist now on Steam
